name: Aadhaar address update
description: Update the address recorded in Aadhaar, online on the myAadhaar portal (OTP to the registered mobile number) or at an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre, with a supporting proof of address.
description_hi: आधार में दर्ज पता अपडेट करें — myAadhaar पोर्टल पर ऑनलाइन (पंजीकृत मोबाइल नंबर पर OTP के साथ) या आधार नामांकन केंद्र पर, पते के सहायक प्रमाण के साथ।
verification_notes: Proof-of-address eligibility comes from UIDAI List IV (update, any age). The PDF marks allowed/not-allowed with images, so each row was checked visually on 2026-11-14. Only a subset of the accepted documents is modelled; the full list is in the source PDF. Head-of-Family and family-member-declaration routes are not modelled. Fees are not modelled.

requirements.name: Existing Aadhaar number
requirements.description: The update is made against an existing Aadhaar number.

evidence.excerpt: The online mode offers address update to the Aadhaar number holders where the Aadhaar number holder can directly place the address update request on the myAadhaar portal. evidence.source_title: Updating Data on Aadhaar - UIDAI
